category: Application Library examples: Battery Design Module (2/2)
description: Ready-made, documented example simulations installed with the Battery Design Module. Each lists its physics interfaces, couplings and study steps; solve one with comsol_run_example or adapt its Java build script.

tools.name: Single-Particle Modeling of Lithium-Ion Batteries [Battery Design Module example]
tools.description: Application Library example of the Battery Design Module (Lithium-Ion Batteries, Performance): Single-Particle Modeling of Lithium-Ion Batteries. Physics interfaces: Lumped Battery (lb), Lithium-Ion Battery (liion2), Lithium-Ion Battery (liion). Study steps: Current Distribution Initialization, Time Dependent. A ready model to start from for a similar simulation.

COMSOL: File > Application Libraries > Battery Design Module > Lithium-Ion Batteries, Performance > lib single particle
